changes.checkboxHooks: Added optional caller-owned Foldkit event attributes onClick/onPointerDown. A supplied onClick replaces the primitive's default toggle, so the caller owns the message and its ClickOptions (defaultAction: Prevent, propagation: Stop) and can preventDefault/stopPropagation; onPointerDown is attached as-is. Proven by the new Scene test: caller message handled, ancestor handler not reached (propagation stopped), no default toggle.
changes.checkboxDataDisabled: Removed the invented data-disabled marker (live checkbox-control.tsx emits none); the disabled test now asserts the attribute is absent.
changes.inputTextarea: Added inputMode and autoComplete pass-through, rendered as h.InputMode/h.Autocomplete (live: storage-retention.tsx:461, studio-images.tsx:169/178, operator-controls.tsx:378).
changes.classAssertions: Input/textarea/checkbox tests now assert the FULL class attribute equals the exported constants (fieldClassName + caller class; checkbox base+state) instead of 2-3 tokens, and the input/checkbox tests freeze those constants against their live literals, so deleting focus-visible:ring-[3px], placeholder:* or shadow-xs now fails.
changes.buttonComposition: Dropped tailwind-merge (cn) for live plain concatenation: block form is base + ' w-full' (design-system.ts:1252) and the view joins base+className with a space. Rendered classes change only when a caller className conflicts with a base utility: both are kept instead of twMerge deleting the loser. No scene test passes className; button suite stays 7/7.
changes.antiSlop: Removed the runtime typeof narrowing ((x ?? "").trim() instead) and the uncommented id/label type assertions in the checkbox label path.

notPreserved: input: no isReadOnly/isInvalid/hasDescription/onBlur (the vendored input has them; the live RM3 field contract does not use them in the copied helpers). Label is rendered as an explicit <label for> rather than the live implicit <label> nesting, because Scene's accessibleName does not resolve ancestor labels; semantic association is equivalent.
textarea: same omissions as input; no default height or mono styling (live call sites decide these); className is appended verbatim.

checkbox: no hidden input/name (the live RM3 button-based checkbox contributes no form value; only the vendored checkbox has a hidden input). aria-label remains the primary live naming path; the explicit id+label path is an additive form-style option. Space-key activation relies on native button semantics and cannot be simulated by Scene (no default-action simulation), so the Space-key default action is not simulated; the click path and caller-supplied click/pointerdown attributes are proven. No data-checked marker (live does not emit one).
